reason: The description is an accurate and thorough mapping of every step in the implementation. incorrect_or_misleading_points: Saying 'attaches/reset location data … via a locData property' slightly conflates the side-effectful reset with the assignment; the implementation calls `resetLocData()` and assigns its return value, so the reset is a side effect of the call, not a separate step on the expression node.
